canonicalization.rules: URL whitespace stripped; missing scheme receives http://; HTTP(S) only; scheme and hostname lowercased; trailing hostname dot removed; path defaults to /; query retained byte-for-byte; fragment removed; userinfo and explicit port retained; invalid port/host rejected.

source.name: PhiUSIIL cleaned random split seed 42 train fold

target.name: PhreshPhish cleaned temporal test; Experiment 4 output 20261022T170935017991Z

hostname_rule: Experiment 5 parse_url: urllib hostname lowercased and trailing dot removed.

prediction_join.method: unique immutable PhreshPhish row_id reconstructed from test shard filename and original zero-based row position

registrable_domain_rule: Experiment 5 host_parts with bundled tldextract PSL; IP literals remain the IP; unknown suffix falls back to e.domain or host.

strict_no_overlap_subset.definition: Target rows having no matching raw URL, shared canonical URL, hostname, or registrable domain in any source training row.

target_url_hash_rule: Reconstructed target URLs are validated against split_test.url_sha256 using SHA-256(canonical_url(raw URL)), matching Experiment 4 verify_end_to_end.py.
